{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''[&hellip;]'' Commandant, get someone down to my ship to show them where the racks and storage cradles are.''"<br />"''Opfo, make it happen.|[[Han Solo]] and Commandant Barcelle|<ref name="Choices" />}}
'''Opfo''' was an individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] aboard the [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Poln Major]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> during a [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] over Poln Major between the Empire and [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Eastern Fleet]], the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] of the Golan, [[Commandant/Legends|Commandant]] [[Barcelle]], commanded Opfo to guide the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]&mdash;who was secretly a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]&mdash;to the space station's [[Missile/Legends|missile]] racks so that [[Gender/Legends|he]] could arm the Golan with more missiles to destroy Esva's [[Whisperlike fighter]]s. The battle ended with the destruction of Esva's forces and the [[Alien/Legends|alien's]] retreat.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Opfo was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
